title: Attack surface mapping: inputs, outputs and dependencies

videos.script: Every threat so far arrived through a door. A sign-in form. An upload. A webhook. A console login. {{doors}} The attack surface is the list of those doors. Every place data can come in, every place it goes out, and everything you run that you did not write. {{surface}} You would think a team knows its own doors. The clinic's did not. Its drawing showed four ways in, and the system has five, because the staff console answers from the whole internet. {{five}} Today you list the surface from the model, find the missing door, and add it. Then you look at the doors nobody draws: the libraries and services the portal trusts. {{deps}} And you will learn to measure the surface by the doors a stranger can open, because that is the number that falls when you actually make it smaller. {{measure}}
